answer: In this PoA network, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays under an exponential temporal half-life; therefore, an agent must deliver sustained honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted incoming weight, and cannot pass consensus. Identities named ferrous, walnut, or vine gain no shortcut without durable, corroborated behavior.
